summary:
Worked the Authorization lane (athz) on shop.lab.test using the alice (customer) and carol (admin) test accounts, read-only. Reachable paths used: /account/settings, /static/app.js(.map), and API endpoints discovered in app.js (/api/v1/items, /api/v1/cart, /api/v1/orders, /api/v1/orders/{id}, /api/v1/admin/users). Note /admin returns 404 for all callers.

Findings:
- WSTG-ATHZ-04 (IDOR) DONE — CONFIRMED. /api/v1/orders list is per-user scoped (alice=1001, carol=1002) but the object endpoint /api/v1/orders/{id} has no ownership check: alice read carol's order 1002 in full (name, SKU, total, shipping address). Sequential ids. Recorded as high lead.
- WSTG-ATHZ-03 (privilege escalation) DONE — CONFIRMED. /api/v1/admin/users returns the full user/role list to alice (customer), byte-identical to carol (admin); unauthenticated it's 401. Authentication is checked but role is not. Recorded as high lead. (The registration hidden role=customer field from recon is a separate priv-esc vector but requires a write/registration, not testable in this read-only lane.)
- WSTG-ATHZ-02 (authz schema bypass) DONE — CONFIRMED via both the horizontal (orders IDOR) and vertical (admin namespace reachable by customer) cases above; authorization is enforced inconsistently (auth present, object/role checks absent).
- WSTG-ATHZ-01 (directory traversal / file inclusion) DONE — not vulnerable via read-only probing. nginx rejects traversal against /static (400) for plain and URL-encoded dot-segments; API stubs ignore path/param traversal payloads.

All items marked done. Writes were not permitted, so the registration role-field escalation and any POST/GraphQL mutation paths were left for a write-authorized lane.
